title: Luxury Sri Lanka: Kandy, Bentota and Colombo in Five Star Hotels
alt: Infinity pool of a five star beach resort at Bentota
transport: Private air conditioned car with an English speaking chauffeur guide throughout

stops.name: Kandy
stops.accom: 1 night · Breakfast · Deluxe room · 5★ · Five star riverside hotel on the banks of the Mahaweli

activities.name: Private visit to Pinnawala
activities.description: A private stop at the elephant sanctuary to watch the herd at the river before continuing up to Kandy.

activities.name: Private Kandy lake drive and dance show
activities.description: An evening circuit of the lake by private car, then reserved seats for the drummers, masked dancers and fire walkers.

program.name: Kandy
program.description: One night on the river at Kandy with a private visit to the Pinnawala elephants on the way and a private lake drive and dance show.

stops.name: Bentota
stops.accom: 2 nights · Breakfast · Deluxe room · 5★ · Five star Geoffrey Bawa designed resort between river and sea

activities.name: Kosgoda turtle hatchery
activities.description: The hatchery south of Bentota where eggs are protected and hatchlings released into the sea at dusk.

activities.name: Madu Ganga boat safari
activities.description: A boat through the mangrove channels and islands of the Madu wetland, including the cinnamon island and the island temple.

activities.name: Bentota beach
activities.description: An afternoon on the long golden strand between the river mouth and the reef.

program.name: Bentota
program.description: Two nights in a Bawa designed resort with a tea estate stop on the way down, the turtle hatchery, a Madu Ganga boat safari and the beach.

stops.name: Colombo
stops.accom: 1 night · Breakfast · Deluxe room · 5★ · Five star tower hotel with a rooftop pool over the Colombo skyline

activities.name: Private full day Colombo sightseeing
activities.description: Galle Face Green, the Gangaramaya temple, the colonial Fort district, the Lotus Tower and Pettah market by private car.

program.name: Colombo
program.description: A last night high above the capital with a private full day of its temples, colonial quarter and markets.

day_titles.1: Arrival in Colombo and on to Kandy

1: Arrival at Bandaranaike International and private transfer inland
A private stop at the Pinnawala elephant sanctuary
Check in at your riverside hotel in Kandy
A private lake drive and the Kandyan dance performance
2: Breakfast, then a transfer down through the tea country
A plantation and factory visit with a tasting
The Kosgoda turtle hatchery before the coast
Check in at your Bentota resort for sunset
3: Breakfast, then a boat safari on the Madu Ganga
Mangrove tunnels, the cinnamon island and the island temple
Optional: a spa treatment at the resort
4: Breakfast and a private transfer up the coast to Colombo
Galle Face Green and the Gangaramaya temple complex
The Fort district, the Lotus Tower and Pettah market
Check in and an evening at the rooftop pool
5: Breakfast at the hotel and check out
Private transfer to Bandaranaike International for your flight home

expert.name: Aditya
expert.role: Sri Lanka expert at Hi Tours
expert.quote: Bentota is where the trip exhales. After the temples and tea estates, three nights by the water is exactly the right medicine.
expert.tip: Ask for an early start on the Galle day. The fort ramparts are empty before ten and the light on the lighthouse is at its best.

summary: Five days in five star hotels: a night on the river at Kandy with a private dance show, two in a Bawa designed resort at Bentota with the turtle hatchery and a Madu Ganga boat safari, and a last night above the Colombo skyline.
included: Included: 4 nights in five star hotels with breakfast; private airport transfers and all road travel in an air conditioned car with chauffeur guide; a private Pinnawala elephant sanctuary visit; private Kandy lake drive and Kandyan dance show; the Kosgoda turtle hatchery; a Madu Ganga boat safari; Bentota beach time; a private full day Colombo sightseeing tour.
not_included: Not included: international flights; Sri Lanka ETA visa fees; lunches and dinners; entrance tickets where payable locally; travel insurance; optional excursions; tips and personal expenses.
